Values against P2's rows: 4 high-speed channels MCLK, MO, MSS (host to pack) and SO (pack to host) = 3 forward and 1 reverse (Table 20 pins 3, 4, 6, 16); A grade SPI clock 1 MHz max, 2 Mbps a channel (Table 1), pulse width min 100 ns; tPLH/tPHL 25 ns max on MCLK, MO, SO and 21 to 25 ns on MSS at 5 V (Table 1), so forward + ADBMS1818 t8 60 ns + reverse = 110 ns inside the 500 ns half period; VDD1 and VDD2 each 3.0 to 5.5 V, independent (3.3 V host, 5 V pack side), VIH 0.7 x VDDx, VOH VDDx - 0.1 V at -20 uA (Table 3); IDD2 6.0 typ, 10.5 max mA at 1 MHz A grade and 5 V (Table 2), IDD2(Q) 6.1 typ mA (Table 3, maximum not stated), so the pack-side 5 V rail carries 16.5 + 8.1 + 10.5 = 35.1 mA awake against 31.0 mA for ISO7741DWR, inside the 300 mA P2 states for LTM8068's VOUT2; VIORM 565 V peak (Table 19 gives the AC bipolar figure only, no DC figure, as for the ADuM141E1 rows P2 passed), above 85 V DC; -40 to +125 C. Power-off default is high impedance on both sides (Table 23), so CS idles high only with a pack-side pull-up on SSS (stage 2); the host-unpowered case is not a value in Pins.md. exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: Fail 'chip select idle high' (Pins.md:151-155): the F suffix defaults low on input power loss (SLLSEP4K section 4, SLLSFJ6G p. 1, SLLSFK1C section 5)
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: Pins.md:151-155 (checkout 7e74cd442a79, read 2026-10-03) says only that every chip select has an external pull-up of about 10 kOhm and that RP2350 pads come out of reset pulled down (32 to 86 kOhm), which would select every chip while the coprocessor resets. In that state the host rail is up, the isolator input is high and an F part's output is high; the F suffix acts only when the input side loses power. No line of Pins.md, IOBoard.md or Research.md (checked by grep for 'unpowered', 'host side', 'host-side') states a host-side-unpowered case, so 'CS stays deasserted while the host side is unpowered' is P2's addition and not a requirement value. In that case an F part holds CSB, SCK and SDI at 0 V; with P2's own wake value (SCK - CSB at least 200 mV for 240 ns) the difference is 0 mV, so it does not wake the ADBMS1818. The drop stands only if the owner adds a host-unpowered requirement. At JLCPCB the F rows do not displace rank 1 or 2 (ISO7741FDWR 1.7509 at 1 and ISO6741FDWR 1.9167 at 1 per FU-2D, against 1.4745 for ISO7741DWR), so they are alternates, not new first choices.

The part still does not qualify as P2's barrier and pack-side supply in one: data outputs default low (Table 32), VISO is 4.7 V min with load regulation 5 % max (Table 3), so 4.47 V at the data sheet's bound against the 4.5 V minimum, and IISO(MAX) is 30 mA against 16.5 + 8.1 mA + IDD2 6.85 mA max at 1 Mbps (Table 4) = 31.45 mA. JLCPCB stock 517 / 504 at 17.123 at 1 piece (vendors.py jlcpcb C2830727, 2026-10-03T11:07:44Z). As a barrier alone, with VDDP unused, it is a pricier alternate that defaults low, below ISO7741DWR.

missed_functions.why: IOBoard.md:475 names it as a required line: per cell voltage and resistance under load, and per pack capacity and drawn mAh. P2's 'Cell monitor' entry carries per-cell voltage and resistance under load from the INA228's motor current (its 'quantities' row) but nothing for the per-pack capacity and drawn mAh, and no entry or source of those two figures (the INA228's charge register is R8's, not named in R9).
